explanation: Chronologically: the Poona Pact (Sept 1932), then the Third Round Table Conference (Nov-Dec 1932), then the August Offer (1940) -- giving II, III, I.
Alphabetically the four words order as Rumbustious, Ruminate, Rumour, Rumple, putting 'Ruminate' in second place.

Chronologically: the Simon Commission's appointment (1927), the Nehru Report (1928), the (second) Labour Government's formation in Britain (1929), then the First Round Table Conference (1930) -- giving I, III, II & IV.
'Appointed...oversee' fits naturally: a committee appointed to oversee a transformation project.
'Plenty...still' fits the contrast: despite plenty of overtime, he still can't support his family.
